method: Reviewed the nine synthetic Flutter harness captures at their native rendered resolution; contact sheet and per-chart captures were checked for clipping, overlap, contrast, legend wrapping, selection/today markers, and empty-state semantics.

findings.habit: Chinese light and English dark captures show aligned weekday labels, flat progress cells, readable month labels, and stable selection/today affordances. The 320px capture at 2x text scale remains vertically readable without clipped controls.
findings.activity: The weighted activity title, summary, chart, and legend remain distinguishable in both dark widths. The narrow capture wraps content while preserving chart bounds and does not overlap controls.
findings.mood: Named mood categories, no-diary and no-mood states remain visually distinct. Chinese light and English dark captures keep the legend readable; the narrow large-text capture wraps without clipping or overlap.

correction: Earlier review incorrectly accepted dark captures. Raw images show low-contrast inherited light-fixture headings/icons. New harness captures and an actual per-image review are required.
